{{Quote|Ugh. Spaceports all smell the same. Engine exhaust, coolant fluid and spacers who haven't bathed in a week. Let's get out of this stink. Whatever the rest of Dromund Kaas is like, the air's gotta be fresher than in here.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]]|<ref name="TOR:THoDK">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Hunt on Dromund Kaas|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>}}
'''Docking Bay O-17''' was a docking bay in the [[Dromund Kaas spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. It handled arrivals and departures to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]].
